instruction: The spreadsheet has daily work hours and an hourly rate of 25. Suppose the hourly rate were 30 instead. Calculate the total earned amount at this new rate and put the result as a plain number in cell G3.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully calculated total earned by multiplying time-format total hours by hourly rate using =SUM(B3:B7)*24*F3 formula in E3, yielding 191.6667.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can handle time-to-number conversion (*24), use SUM for time ranges, multiply time values by numeric rates in LibreOffice Calc.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests same time*number skill with a different hypothetical hourly rate (30 instead of 25), placed in a different cell (G3).
metadata.explanation: Agent must compute total hours * 30 using the *24 conversion trick for time values and put the numeric result in G3. Expected: 7.6667 * 30 = 230.0.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads cell G3 from sheet 0 of the target xlsx file using openpyxl with data_only=True, matching the instruction requirement.
Metric correctly handles the expected parameter for type='rule' by directly accessing expected.get('expected_value') and expected.get('tolerance').
Expected value 230.0 is mathematically correct: total hours ~7.6667 (from original 191.6667/25) multiplied by new rate 30 = 230.0.
Postconfig properly activates the LibreOffice Calc window and saves the file (Ctrl+S) before the getter reads it, ensuring fresh cached values.
Single instruction requirement (numeric result in G3) is fully covered by the evaluator.
